note: Closed vocabulary of Raise Capacity rejection keywords for the Rejection Explanation Agent. Every keyword is detected by Python ONLY from a confirmed failure of a complete applicable requirement in the eligibility evidence (academic_requirement.confirmed_failures, or checks.capacity.status NOT_SATISFIED). Unresolved, conflicting or unevaluated evidence never maps to a keyword, and one failed alternative of a requirement that is satisfied or unresolved is never a failure. Gemini can only reference these ids. Placeholders are filled from the verified evidence only. 'topic_terms' are used to drop explanations that discuss a requirement that did not fail.

prerequisite_not_completed.label: Prerequisite course not completed
prerequisite_not_completed.policy_basis: The course's prerequisite course must be completed with a passing grade in a term before the requested term.
prerequisite_not_completed.plain_reason: There is no record of you completing the required prerequisite course(s) {course_list} in an earlier term.
prerequisite_not_completed.supportive_guidance: Completing {course_list} with a passing grade would meet this requirement.

prerequisite_not_passed.label: Prerequisite course not passed
prerequisite_not_passed.policy_basis: A prerequisite course counts only when a passing grade under the approved grade policy is recorded in a term before the requested term.
prerequisite_not_passed.plain_reason: No passing grade is recorded for the required prerequisite course(s) {course_list}; the recorded grade(s) ({grades}) do not meet the passing requirement.
prerequisite_not_passed.concise_reason: no passing grade recorded for prerequisite course(s) {course_list}
prerequisite_not_passed.supportive_guidance: A passing grade in {course_list} would meet this requirement.

prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.label: No prerequisite option satisfied
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.policy_basis: The course's requirement lists alternative options; meeting any one of them satisfies it.
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.plain_reason: This course requires one of the following: {options}. None of these options has been met.
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.concise_reason: none of the required options met ({options})
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.supportive_guidance: Meeting any one of these options would satisfy this requirement.

corequisite_not_satisfied.label: Co-requisite not satisfied
corequisite_not_satisfied.policy_basis: A co-requisite course must be completed in an earlier term or taken in the same term as the requested course.
corequisite_not_satisfied.plain_reason: The course(s) {course_list} must be completed in an earlier term or taken in the same term as this course, and no such record was found.
corequisite_not_satisfied.concise_reason: co-requisite course(s) {course_list} neither completed nor taken in the same term
corequisite_not_satisfied.supportive_guidance: Completing {course_list} or taking it in the same term would meet this requirement.

academic_standing_not_satisfied.label: Academic standing not met
academic_standing_not_satisfied.policy_basis: The course requires an academic standing, measured by completed credit hours against the approved standing threshold.
academic_standing_not_satisfied.plain_reason: This course requires {standing}, which needs at least {required_credits} completed credit hours; you have completed {completed_hours} credit hours.
academic_standing_not_satisfied.concise_reason: {standing} not met ({completed_hours} of the required {required_credits} completed credit hours)
academic_standing_not_satisfied.supportive_guidance: Reaching at least {required_credits} completed credit hours would meet this requirement.

no_remaining_capacity.label: No remaining section capacity
no_remaining_capacity.policy_basis: A Raise Capacity request can only be accommodated while the section's current capacity is below its maximum allowed capacity (total plus additional capacity).
no_remaining_capacity.plain_reason: Section {section_id} has reached its maximum allowed capacity ({current_capacity} of {maximum_allowed_capacity}), so no additional seat remains.
no_remaining_capacity.concise_reason: Section {section_id} is at its maximum allowed capacity of {maximum_allowed_capacity}

templates.formal: Your Raise Capacity request for {course_id} ({course_name}), Section {section_id}, cannot be approved because it does not meet the following requirement(s). {plain_reasons}
templates.supportive: Thank you for your Raise Capacity request for {course_name}. At this time it does not meet the following requirement(s). {plain_reasons} {supportive_guidance}
